chunks: And whatever is in it regarding the will of Amir Al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, to his son Muhammad ibn Al-Hanafiyyah - may Allah be pleased with him - I have narrated it from my father - may Allah be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from someone who mentioned it from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him.

Most people make an error in this chain of transmission by replacing Hammad ibn Isa with Hammad ibn Uthman, whereas Ibrahim ibn Hashim did not meet Hammad ibn Uthman; rather, he met Hammad ibn Isa and narrated from him.

key_terms.حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى: Hammad ibn Isa, a key narrator
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ: Muhammad ibn Al-Hanafiyyah, son of Ali

ai.seo_question: Who is the correct narrator in the chain for the will of Amir Al-Mu'minin to Muhammad ibn Al-Hanafiyyah?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq meticulously corrects a common isnad error in the transmission of Imam Ali’s will to Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah, distinguishing between the similar-named narrators Hammad ibn Isa and Hammad ibn Uthman. This precise verification underscores the rigorous standards of Shia hadith scholarship in preserving the authenticity of key familial and theological documents. By clarifying that Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from Hammad ibn Isa, the text reinforces the reliability of the chain leading to the Imams.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: And whatever is narrated regarding the will of Amir Al-Muʾminin, peace be upon him, to his son Muhammad ibn Al-Hanafiyyah - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Hammad ibn ʿIsa, from someone who mentioned it from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him.

Most people make an error in this chain of transmission by replacing Hammad ibn ʿIsa with Hammad ibn Uthman, whereas Ibrahim ibn Hashim did not meet Hammad ibn Uthman; rather, he met Hammad ibn ʿIsa and narrated from him.
